ja: 昨日からずっと先方の返信を待っています。
en: I've been waiting for their reply since yesterday.
alternatives: I've been waiting to hear back since yesterday.
I've been waiting on their reply since yesterday.
point: ずっと待っている は have been waiting、since で起点

ja: 先方を CC に入れておけばよかった。
en: I wish I'd cc'd the client on it.
alternatives: If only I'd copied the client on it.
I wish I had copied the client.
I should have cc'd the client on it.
point: 過去の後悔は wish の後に過去完了

ja: 昨日のメール、添付がなかったです。
en: Yesterday's email had no attachment.
alternatives: Yesterday's email didn't have an attachment.
There was no attachment in yesterday's email.
point: 「なかった」は had no ～ か didn't have で言う

ja: 先方が聞きたいのは、納期を変更できるかどうかです。
en: What they're asking is whether we can reschedule.
alternatives: What they want to know is if we can reschedule.
What they're wondering is whether we can move the date.
What they're asking is whether the deadline can change.
point: What 節が主語、「〜かどうか」は whether で語順は平叙文

ja: 確定には、金曜までに正確な数量がほしいのですが。
en: To finalize, we'd need the exact quantity by Friday.
alternatives: We'd need the exact quantity by Friday to finalize.
To finalize this, we'd need exact numbers by Friday.
I'd need the exact quantity by Friday to finalize.
point: 目的の「〜には」は To do で文頭に。we'd need で柔らかく

ja: 添付ファイルが2つあります。
en: There are two attachments.
alternatives: Two files are attached.
The email has two attachments.
point: 複数のものがあるときは There are を使う

ja: うちは毎日Slackを使う。
en: We use Slack every day.
alternatives: We use Slack daily.
Our team uses Slack daily.
point: 「毎日」は every day。前置詞は付けない

ja: 部長が今朝、議事録を添付して全員に送りました。
en: This morning the manager emailed everyone, attaching the minutes.
alternatives: The manager emailed everyone this morning with the minutes attached.
The manager emailed everyone this morning, attaching the minutes.
point: 「添付して」は attaching で文の後ろにつなげる

ja: 請求書は、経理に今週中に直してもらいます。
en: I'll have accounting fix the invoice this week.
alternatives: I'll get accounting to fix the invoice this week.
I'll have accounting correct the invoice this week.
point: have＋人＋動詞の原形。to は付けない

ja: 来週の金曜に、私たちがうかがいます。
en: We're coming to see you next Friday.
alternatives: We'll visit you next Friday.
We're visiting you next Friday.
point: 決まった予定は be + ing で表せる

ja: 会議で決めたこと、チームのチャットに貼ってもらえますか？
en: Could you post what we settled on to the team chat?
alternatives: Could you post what we decided to the team chat?
Would you mind putting what we agreed on in the team chat?
point: 「決めたこと」は what we settled on で post の目的語に

ja: 君が早く言ってくれてたら、返信間に合ったのに。
en: If you'd said earlier, I'd have replied on time.
alternatives: If you'd told me sooner, I'd have replied in time.
If you'd said something sooner, I'd have replied on time.
point: 過去の反実仮想は if + had 過去分詞、主節は would have

ja: 先にこの提案書をざっと見てもらえる？
en: Could you look over this proposal first?
alternatives: Can you skim this proposal first?
Could you go over this proposal first?
point: 「ざっと目を通す」は look over / go over

ja: ちょっとアドバイスをもらえますか？
en: Could you give me some advice?
alternatives: Can you give me some advice?
Could I get some advice?
point: advice は数えられないので advices にしない

ja: 田中さんに私へ電話するよう伝えて。
en: Please tell Mr. Tanaka to call me.
alternatives: Could you tell Mr. Tanaka to call me?
Can you ask Mr. Tanaka to call me?
point: 「人に〜するよう伝える」は tell + 人 + to do

ja: チャットで返信してください。
en: Please reply in the chat.
alternatives: Reply in the chat, please.
Please answer in the chat.
point: 「チャットで」は in the chat と冠詞を付ける

ja: 彼女が見積もりの条件をもう確認したか分かりません。
en: I'm not sure whether she's already checked the quote's terms.
alternatives: I don't know if she's looked over the terms yet.
I have no idea if she's gone through the terms.
point: 間接疑問は whether / if の後を平叙文の語順にする

ja: 先方は、月曜までに送ると言っていましたよ。
en: The client said they'd send it by Monday.
alternatives: The client told us they'd send it by Monday.
They said they'd send it by Monday.
point: said に合わせて will を would にする

ja: うちが延長を頼んだら、先方は嫌がるかな？
en: If we asked for an extension, would they mind?
alternatives: Would they mind if we asked for an extension?
Would they mind if we asked for more time?
point: 仮定の話なので if 節は過去形、主節は would

ja: 先方が昨日返信をくれていたら、今ごろ終わってるのに。
en: If they'd replied yesterday, we'd be done by now.
alternatives: If they'd gotten back to us yesterday, we'd be finished.
If they'd written back yesterday, we'd be finished by now.
point: 過去の仮定は had replied、今の結果は would be で時制を分ける

ja: 山田さん、返事なし。僕のチャット見逃したかも。
en: Yamada hasn't replied. He might have missed my chat.
alternatives: Yamada hasn't answered, so he may have missed my chat.
No reply from Yamada. Maybe he overlooked my chat.
point: 過去の推量は might miss ではなく might have missed
